title: Vitruvyan Motus Risk & Control Registry, v1
description: ADR-036. A jurisdiction-agnostic declaration of risks, controls, and their relationships. Registry validity proves only that the declaration is well formed; it does not prove that a risk exists, that a control ran or is effective, or that any compliance obligation is satisfied.

system.description: Optional declaration of the exact system-manifest revision to which this registry applies. This edge does not prove deployment, approval, or control application.

risks.description: Declared risks. An empty array is valid and is not a claim that the system has no risks.

controls.description: Declared controls. Presence here is never evidence that a control ran or was effective.

created_at.description: When this registry revision was created. RCR3 validates the calendar value; this is not assessment time, approval time, or legal time.

supersedes.description: Optional fingerprint of the registry revision this document declares it supersedes. This lineage claim does not rewrite historical evidence.

id.description: Operator-assigned stable registry identity across revisions.

version.description: Operator-assigned revision label. It is metadata, not the cryptographic identity of this document.

manifest_fingerprint.description: Derived fingerprint of the exact System Manifest revision. Registry validation checks shape only and does not retrieve or verify the manifest.

category.description: Operator-defined neutral category. Motus assigns no legal or regulatory meaning to this value.

likelihood.description: Optional operator declaration on an operator-defined scale; not a Motus assessment.

impact.description: Optional operator declaration on an operator-defined scale; not a Motus assessment.

treatment.description: Optional operator-declared treatment label with no built-in legal meaning.

policy_ref.description: Opaque reference to an operator-owned policy. Registry validation does not retrieve or approve it.

enforcement_point.description: Neutral operator-declared point where the control is intended to be enforced; not evidence that it ran.

control_type.description: Operator-defined neutral classification with no built-in regulatory meaning.

risk_refs.description: Explicit many-to-many edges to risks declared in this registry. RCR2 requires every identifier to resolve locally; an empty array is valid.
